subject: special-vault-treasure-island

treasureCadence.charmTrack: Charms can be a separate collectible layer and should not replace major relic cadence.

allowedUiState: exterior, atrium, and vault journey view

repeatableChecks: targeted TypeScript check for Vault lab modules

browserQaEvidence.visualReview: Phone-size exterior, palace atrium, vault room, reveal states, inspect states, and all eight treasures were recaptured and inspected on 2026-08-28. The v058 material-and-lighting run adds five exterior POVs, preserves the full palace journey, and verifies the museum ritual: selected relics move from authored sockets to a central inspection stage, the previous relic returns, the compact plaque keeps the collection visible, the HUD reports eight relics and 89,200 lab-derived value, and the celebration uses saturated gold rings, warm light, and gemstone sparkles. Both the Inspect command and direct 3D canvas raycast opened the Sapphire Astrolabe close-up. The full 17-capture, 16-interaction runtime gate passed.
